text.zh_HK: 1979年，深水埗。頭頂一架航機轉彎，成條街靜三秒——呢個年代，連時間都係靠飛機報時。
text.zh_CN: 1979年，深水埗。头顶一架航机转弯，整条街静三秒——这个年代，连时间都靠飞机报时。
text.en: Sham Shui Po, 1979. An airliner turns overhead and the street goes quiet for three seconds — in these years even the time is announced by planes.

text.zh_HK: 自家舖頭開咗十年，個招牌已經係街嘅傢俬。
text.zh_CN: 自家铺头开了十年，招牌已经是这条街的家具。
text.en: The family shop has been open ten years; its sign is already part of the street's furniture.

text.zh_HK: 上天台搵光叔，聽啟德嘅故事。
text.zh_CN: 上天台找光叔，听启德的故事。
text.en: Climb to the rooftop and hear Kwong's Kai Tak stories.

text.zh_HK: 牆上嗰張相由1955年望到而家：木箱變貨架，茶壺變收音機，一條街由賭博變成事實。
text.zh_CN: 墙上那张相从1955年望到现在：木箱变货架，茶壶变收音机，一条街由赌博变成事实。
text.en: The wall photograph runs from 1955 to now: crates became shelves, the teapot became a radio, and a street went from gamble to fact.

text.zh_HK: 電車票喺你手度由舊變黃。你返到2027年——屋企嘅故事，仲有兩頁。
text.zh_CN: 电车票在你手里由旧变黄。你回到2027年——这个家的故事，还有两页。
text.en: The tram ticket yellows in your hand. You are back in 2027 — two pages of this family's story remain.

_comment: Chapter-4 arc (PLAN §12.1): the generation that moved up — the shop as a fixture, the son's plan, Kai Tak overhead. The tram ticket is the door; offline fallback lines carry every flag beat.
